name: Coval
description: Connect Claude to your Coval workspace to inspect agents, test sets, test cases, personas, metrics, and evaluation runs. Build or update evaluation fixtures, launch safe chat and SMS evaluation runs, and ask Sofia for grounded, read-only analysis and recommendations. The Claude connector does not start voice, outbound voice, or WebSocket voice runs.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Coval to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Coval to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.coval.dev/claude/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Coval MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coval lists 19 MCP tools, including consult_sofia, create_agent, create_run, create_test_case, create_test_set, get_agent, get_metric, get_persona, get_run, get_test_case, get_test_set, and list_agents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Coval?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Coval in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Coval requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Coval is developed by Coval. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
